plain: A person who owes a legal duty or debt

webster.text: The person who binds himself or gives his bond to another.

example.quote: Have you a jury when a motion is made for the commonwealth against an individual ; or when a motion is made by one joint obligor against another, to recover sums paid as security ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 20, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
